description: Uniform cantilever beam, semi-span 100 in, total semi-span lift 1000 lb.

V_root.basis: Uniform load root shear V = L

M_root.basis: Uniform load root moment M = L * b_half / 2

M_front_root.basis: Single front spar carries full moment

z_tip_front.basis: Uniform cantilever deflection delta = w L^4 / (8 EI) using 3 x 0.065 6061-T6 tube EI
